how_to_apply: Open the recruitment section and select Advertisement No. 01/BMHRC/Bhopal/2026.
Read the official notification and online-application instructions.
Complete registration using your name, Aadhaar number, date of birth, email address and mobile number.
Log in using the registration credentials received after successful registration.
Enter the educational qualification, experience, category and other required information.
Upload the photograph, signature and supporting documents in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Check every entry carefully because no editing facility will be available after final submission.
Submit the application and save or print the completed form for future reference.
Only online applications will be accepted. Applicants should not send a hard copy at the application stage.
important_instructions: The crucial date for determining age, qualification and experience is 23 October 2026. Submit a separate online application for every post. content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification and Age Limit
content_sections.text: The required qualification and experience must be completed by 23 October 2026 . Experience will generally be counted only after obtaining the prescribed essential qualification.

rows.essential_qualification: BE or BTech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
M.Sc. Nursing, or B.Sc./Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with one year of experience in an INC-recognized nursing college. Nursing registration is required.
B.Sc. Nursing, B.Sc. Nursing Honours or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with nursing registration; alternatively, GNM with registration and one year of experience in a hospital having at least 50 beds.
Bachelor's degree, Diploma in Medical Record Technology and two years of hospital medical-record experience.
Degree with two years of experience in cash, accounts and budget work in an eligible government, PSU, autonomous or statutory organization.
Degree in Hotel Management or Home Science with one year of hostel-management experience; alternatively, Diploma in Hotel Management or Catering with three years of relevant experience.
Degree in Perfusion Technology with two years of relevant experience, or Diploma in Perfusion Technology with three years of relevant experience.
Relevant master's degree in nutrition, dietetics, food science or home science; alternatively, a relevant B.Sc., PG Diploma in Dietetics and one year of experience in an eligible 100-bed hospital.
Bachelor's degree in Psychology with two years of Psychiatry Technician experience in an eligible 100-bed hospital or institution.
Degree in Social Work or Sociology, or a degree with a one-year Diploma in Social Work, plus two years of relevant experience in an eligible 100-bed hospital or institution.
Degree with two years of experience in administration, accounts or establishment in an eligible government, PSU, autonomous or statutory body.
B.Sc. with one year of experience in a medical institution; alternatively, 12th Science with a relevant diploma and two years of concerned-field experience.
B.Sc. with one year of experience in a medical institution; alternatively, 12th Science with the prescribed discipline-related diploma and five years of experience.
12th pass with Science, two-year Diploma in Pharmacy and registration with the State Pharmacy Council.
Degree in Pharmacy, or Diploma in Pharmacy with five years of experience as a Medical Storekeeper.
12th with Science, Diploma in Pharmacy and two years of experience as Store Keeper in medical stores.
12th pass with the prescribed dictation and computer-transcription skills. A relevant certificate must be produced.
10th pass with an ITI certificate or equivalent certificate from a recognized institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The BMHRC selection process consists of the following stages: Computer Based Test Skill test for the Personal Assistant post Document verification Medical fitness and final appointment formalities There will be no interview for these Group B and Group C non-gazetted posts. Selection will be based on performance in the CBT, the applicable skill test and successful document verification.

rows.details: 50 marks: General Intelligence, Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, Computer Skills, English and Hindi
English and Hindi, except language-specific questions

content_sections.heading: Personal Assistant Skill Test
content_sections.text: Dictation: 10 minutes at 80 words per minute. English transcription: 50 minutes on a computer. Hindi transcription: 65 minutes on a computer. A relevant skill certificate must be furnished.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMHRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications will be accepted. Applicants should not send a hard copy at the application stage.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Class 10 certificate as proof of age Relevant degree and mark sheets Diploma or postgraduate qualification certificates, where applicable Registration certificate issued by the relevant State Council SC, ST, OBC, EWS or PwBD certificate in the prescribed Government of India format Experience certificate, where required No Objection Certificate for candidates employed in a government department, PSU or autonomous body Valid supporting documents for age relaxation Application form printout when called for document verification

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Applicants
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining age, qualification and experience is 23 October 2026. Submit a separate online application for every post. Examinations for different posts may be conducted during the same shift. Applicants must enter their name and date of birth exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate. No correction will be allowed after final submission. Admit cards will not be sent by post. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the examination. The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease. Selected candidates carry an All India service liability and may be posted anywhere in India. Candidates should rely on the official notification for complete eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under BMHRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BMHRC has announced 66 vacancies, comprising 31 Group B posts and 35 Group C posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BMHRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and fee is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.590 plus applicable transaction charges. SC, ST, PwBD, women and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempt from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BMHRC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years for Group B posts and 27 years for Group C posts. Applicable categories receive relaxation under Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the BMHRC selection process?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a Computer Based Test and document verification. A skill test will also be conducted for the Personal Assistant post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an interview for BMHRC Group B and Group C posts?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that there will be no interview for these non-gazetted Group B and Group C posts.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the BMHRC CBT?
faq.answer: No. The recruitment notification states that the Computer Based Test will not have negative marking.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. However, a separate application is required for each post, and examinations for different posts may be held in the same shift.
